GOG Disc Creator

Turn your GOG offline installer into a classic PC game CD/DVD.

No upload. No account. Everything is processed locally in your browser. The trusted launcher is built into this page.

Privacy: Your GOG installer is never uploaded to this website. The browser reads the file locally and places it directly into the package you download.
1. Game
No installer selected
Select the GOG setup EXE. If GOG supplied one or more .bin files, select the EXE and all matching .bin files together. They are copied unchanged to the disc so multi-part installers can find their data files.
2. Cover & Disc
Optional
Optional
3. Extras (optional)
Choose local files such as manuals, soundtracks or artwork. They are added to the disc package locally.
4. Disc settings
Burning: Extract the downloaded ZIP and burn its contents to the root of your CD/DVD. The package contains autorun.inf and GOGAutoLauncher.exe. If Windows has AutoPlay/AutoRun disabled, open the disc and double-click GOGAutoLauncher.exe.
